narratives.Description: bug(docs): committed RULE-MAP.md is stale vs renderer — blocks v0.119.1 Step 5
narratives.Overview:
## Recurrence
Master CI TypeScript job on b02e17e failed: `packages/core/src/render/rule-map.test.ts` live-repo `--check` expected exit 0, got 1. `task docs:rule-map:check` prints STALE. This blocks `task release` Step 5 for v0.119.1.

## Root cause
Committed `docs/RULE-MAP.md` is 2 lines behind the renderer after recent merged work: skills grouping MUST count 644 to 645, and the `observable-scope.md` related-link line now wraps (`#4586` truncated to ellipsis).

## Acceptance
- [ ] `task docs:rule-map:check` exits 0
- [ ] live-repo `rule-map --check` in `rule-map.test.ts` passes
- [ ] No hand-edits to `docs/RULE-MAP.md`; regenerate with `task docs:rule-map` only

## Recurrence signature
Release Step 5 / CI `docs:rule-map:check` STALE after content or docs changes that were not followed by `task docs:rule-map`.
